payload.rationale: The root cause is an off-by-one operator in the 10% tier check in bulk_discount_pct. The spec (docstring '50+ units -> 10%' and README '50+ units 10%') requires the boundary to be inclusive, and every other tier uses an inclusive comparison (>= 100, >= 10). With `quantity > 50`, ordering exactly 50 units fails the check and falls through to the 5% tier, producing the reported bug. Changing the strict inequality to `quantity >= 50` makes 50 units qualify for 10%, matching the expected test case (50, 10) while leaving 10-49 at 5% and 100+ at 15% unchanged. This is the single minimal change that fixes the root cause.
